purpose: Check whether the frozen-model gradient-conflict findings survive a separately declared FP64 evaluation and cross-host replay. Motivated by preserved FP32 replay exceptions, not by held-out predictive results.
source: Same unchanged all15 ME106 checkpoints, original 180 FIT batches and loss components. Input float32 records are promoted to float64 after original augmentation; existing saved weights promoted to float64. No new labels or optimizer steps.
stopping: One original FP64 panel plus replay; never overwrite FP32 data, waive its exception, tune coefficients, alter gates or train.
limitation: Higher-precision diagnostic is not proof that original FP32 training or inference is bit-identical across hosts. It does not establish predictive improvement. Original FP32 raw-dot replay failure at GitHub40248483108 remains recorded.
